parserSkipReason: This fixture pins currentBlockHeight() inside a private helper AND in a conditional-expression arm (`c ? a : b`) in one contract, so it ships only the surfaces that have a conditional expression, as ternary-expression does: .runar.ts, .runar.sol, .runar.rb and .runar.java spell it `c ? a : b` and .runar.py spells it `a if c else b`. The Move, Go, Rust-DSL and Zig surfaces have no conditional expression (their parsers turn `if` only into a statement). All seven COMPILERS remain full hex/ANF parity targets for the five surfaces (no compilers allowlist).
